title: Does Claude’s Constitution Have a Culture?
reasoning: The study evaluates Claude Sonnet using World Values Survey (WVS) items specifically categorized into domains such as 'Religion & values' (measuring belief in God and religious importance) and 'Moral justifiability' (evaluating attitudes on abortion, euthanasia, etc.). It benchmarks these values against global human data to identify cultural and ethical biases in the model's alignment.
